item: The urllib3 log filter fails closed over every carrier and is default-deny over a table read from the installed library, the library is bounded to the releases read, and scripts/guards_for_diff.py picks the checks to run before a first push
key_paths: src/ingest/urllib3_log.py; tests/test_urllib3_log_withholds_the_path.py; src/llm/installer.py; tests/test_session_host_list.py; pyproject.toml; requirements.lock; configs/external_artifacts.yml; docs/maintenance/EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCIES.md; .github/workflows/ci.yml; tests/test_external_freshness.py; scripts/guards_for_diff.py; tests/test_guards_for_diff.py; docs/maintenance/PRE_PUSH_GUARDS.md; docs/SECURITY.md; docs/ledger/OPEN_QUEUE.md
summary: CORRECTION: the filter #1414 merged did not cut the header-parsing record (Failed to parse headers passes the HeaderParsingError object and exc_info=True; its text is the raw header bytes the server sent after its first malformed line, a Location with its signed query included), so a signed Location reached the log and the error journal on main; this PR fixes it. The filter now treats every carrier of a record as untrusted (message, each argument of any type, exc_info, exc_text, stack_info, extra attributes) and carries a table of every log call urllib3 makes on its nine loggers, read from 2.7.0 and 2.8.0 (identical templates and arguments): a record that matches an entry has its target arguments rewritten and its other arguments reduced, and a record that matches NO entry, or whose handling raises, has its message withheld whole (logger, level and exception class name kept; arguments, traces and extras gone; never dropped); a log-record factory applies the same rule to any other logger under the urllib3 name. A test reads the INSTALLED library's source by AST and fails by name on a new, changed or removed log call, an argument or keyword the table does not name, or a logger the module does not cover; pyproject bounds urllib3 to >=2.7.0,<2.8.1 (the ceiling is the first release not read), the registry entry urllib3-log-shapes records floor, verified release and ceiling with an upstream check, and the CI job urllib3-floor runs the table test on 2.7.0. 63 filter mutants and 8 host-list-walk mutants are each failed by a named test. Not covered, said so: scripts that never import src.ingest and the httpx logger (loopback clients). Also scripts/guards_for_diff.py: before a first push it picks the tests main added since the branch left it (found by the merges into the branch, either way round; --since for a rebase), the tests the branch changed (untracked included), the tests that name a changed helper, node test or data file or sit below a changed conftest, the test files that walk the tree, the blocking ruff lane and the style ratchet with its ceiling READ from ci.yml, and says when the base is ahead of the branch; 40 mutants, all killed. Why: CI found tests/test_sink_sweep_records.py, which main had added and the previous push had not run, and a CI cycle is about fifty-five minutes.
